name: io.github.ocultar-dev/ocultar-pii
description: Zero-egress PII redaction for Claude. Runs locally — no data leaves your infrastructure.

environmentVariables.name: OCULTAR_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of your locally running Ocultar Refinery

environmentVariables.name: OCULTAR_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Ocultar API key (leave blank if not configured)

environmentVariables.name: OCULTAR_AUDITOR_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Enables reveal_tokens, register_entity, list_entities, and seed_entities tools. Must match OCU_AUDITOR_TOKEN on the server.

environmentVariables.name: OCULTAR_SOMBRA_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of the Ocultar Sombra gateway (for sombra_query). Defaults to http://localhost:8086.

environmentVariables.name: OCULTAR_SOMBRA_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Enables sombra_query tool. Required for that tool; leave blank to disable it.
